summary: Architected and deployed automated data pipelines, RPA scrapers, and interactive Power BI dashboards — streamlining project tracking across 20+ global construction datasets and cutting client reporting times by 30%.
responsibilities: Engineered automated RPA bots using Selenium to replace manual data entry, boosting project tracking efficiency by 40%.
Designed robust web scraping pipelines to harvest, clean, and structure real-world data across 20+ international construction datasets.
Built interactive executive Power BI dashboards with custom DAX modeling, empowering client stakeholders with real-time visual insights.
Streamlined complex ETL processes via automated Power Query workflows, cutting recurring report generation times by 30%.
Collaborated directly with international client teams to turn raw business requirements into production-ready data solutions.
